instruction: Recreate this image, with every element editable, and deliver it to me as a one-slide ppt with the same dimensions as the image.

dim1: The deliverable is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened normally.
The delivered PPT contains only 1 slide. The slide uses a landscape 16:9 layout, and the content orientation matches the original image.

The slide does not use a full-slide screenshot or a large screenshot as its main content. The title, axes, tick marks, sensor points, identifier text, green cross-section lines, internal grid lines, legend, and scale description box are all editable objects.
All English titles, axis text, sensor identifiers, and legend text on the slide can be selected and edited individually and are not embedded together as an image.
The slide has no blank area covering more than 50% of its area, and no text overlap, component obstruction, or content overflow affecting more than 50% of the slide.
The slide as a whole recreates the engineering monitoring layout diagram and is not converted into an ordinary line chart, scatter plot, flowchart, infographic, or decorative poster.
dim2: +3: The slide background is white or a very light grayish white. The main diagram area is positioned 0-2cm from the left and 0.8cm–1cm from the top, with an overall width of 36cm–38cm and height of 27cm–29cm.

+3: The main title “RIVERDALE TUNNEL – SECTION 7 MONITORING LAYOUT” appears in the upper-left corner, positioned 2.50cm–3.00cm from the left and 0.55cm–0.75cm from the top. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 15-17 points, the color is black, and the font weight is bold.

+1: The subtitle “Displacement Sensors (mm)” appears below the main title, positioned 2.50cm–3.00cm from the left and 1.10cm–1.30cm from the top. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 15-17 points, and the color is black.

+5: A complete two-dimensional coordinate-axis system appears on the slide. The horizontal axis is a single horizontal solid line, 32cm-34cm long, positioned 2.4cm–2.9cm from the left and 25.5cm-26.5cm from the top. The vertical axis is a single vertical solid line, 32cm-34cm long, positioned 2.3cm–2.8cm from the left and 0.5cm-0.7cm from the top. The axes are black or dark gray, with a line width of 0.5 points.

+3: The horizontal-axis label “Lateral Position (m)” appears 14.5cm–19.5cm from the left and 24cm–29cm from the top. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 14-16 points, and the color is black.

+3: The vertical-axis label “Vertical Position (m)” appears rotated 90 degrees and positioned 0.3cm–0.5cm from the left and 9cm–12cm from the top. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 14-16 points, and the color is black.

+3: The horizontal-axis tick labels “-0.020,” “-0.010,” “0,” “+0.010,” and “+0.020” all appear, arranged from left to right below the horizontal axis. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 7–10 points, and the color is black or dark gray. The corresponding tick marks are short vertical lines, 0.12cm–0.25cm long, with a line width of 0.5 points.

+3: The vertical-axis tick labels “-0.025,” “-0.015,” “-0.005,” “0,” “+0.005,” “+0.015,” and “+0.025” all appear, arranged from bottom to top to the left of the vertical axis. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 13–15 points, and the color is black or dark gray. The corresponding tick marks are short horizontal lines, 0.40cm–0.60cm long, with a line width of 0.5 points.

+3: A horizontal zero-position dashed line appears in the diagram, positioned 13.5cm–14cm from the top and extending horizontally across the diagram from a position 2.3cm–2.8cm from the left. The line is a gray dashed line, 32cm-35cm long, with a line width of 0.5 points and an angle of 0 degrees.

+3: A vertical zero-position dashed line appears in the diagram, positioned 16.5cm–17.3cm from the left and extending vertically across the diagram from a position 2.0–2.5cm from the top. The line is a gray dashed line with a line width of 0.5 points, a length of 22cm-25cm, and an angle of 90 degrees, and it intersects the horizontal zero-position dashed line near the center of the diagram.

+5: The green outer tunnel cross-section outline consists of editable polylines or freeform curves and is positioned overall 2.5cm–3.0cm from the left and 2.00–6.00cm from the top. The line is a single green solid line, with a color close to RGB 20, 145, 45, a line width of 0.75–1.00 points, and no fill or a transparent fill.

+3: The upper boundary of the green cross-section consists of thirteen continuous line segments, extending overall from near a position 2.4cm-2.7cm from the left and 2.3cm-2.5cm from the top to near a position 35cm-37cm from the left and 2.3cm-2.5cm from the top. Each segment is approximately 1.8cm–4.5cm long, and the angles include gently sloping lines from approximately -20 degrees to +20 degrees. The right end has a clearly rising diagonal line.

+3: The lower boundary of the green cross-section consists of twelve continuous line segments, extending overall from near a position 2.4cm-2.7cm from the left and 17cm-19cm from the top to near a position 35cm-37cm from the left and 15cm–17cm from the top. Each segment is approximately 1.5cm–4cm long, and the angles include gently sloping lines from approximately -25 degrees to +25 degrees. The lowest point in the middle is near a position 21cm–23cm from the top.

+3: The left boundary of the green cross-section consists of irregular line segments and is located within 2.3cm–5.0cm from the left. It includes vertical, diagonal, and angled lines. Each segment is 0.8cm–3cm long, and the angles include directions of approximately 60 degrees, 90 degrees, and 120 degrees, forming a continuous irregular closure at the left end.

+3: The right boundary of the green cross-section consists of continuous irregular line segments and is located within 34cm–37cm from the left. It includes upward-sloping, downward-sloping, and near-vertical lines. Each segment is 1cm–4cm long, and the angles include directions of approximately 60 degrees, 90 degrees, and 120 degrees, forming a rising boundary at the right end.

+5: The green internal grid lines consist of approximately 35 editable single solid lines or polylines and cover the main area inside the cross-section. The line color matches the outer outline, close to RGB 20, 145, 45, and the line width is 0.75–1 points. The interior forms an irregular grid of triangles, quadrilaterals, and pentagons.

+3: Approximately 15 horizontal or near-horizontal green lines appear in the internal grid, distributed mainly at positions 7cm–8.5cm, 10.5cm–12.5cm, 9.0cm-11cm, 12cm–14cm, and 13cm-15cm from the top. Each line is 2cm–7cm long, at an angle from -10 degrees to +10 degrees, and is a single green solid line.

+3: Approximately 10 vertical or near-vertical green lines appear in the internal grid, distributed mainly at positions 5cm–7cm, 15cm-17cm, 16cm-18cm, 22cm-24cm, 30cm-32cm, 32cm-34cm, and 17.5cm-19.5cm from the left. Each line is 1.5cm–5cm long, at an angle from 75 degrees to 105 degrees, and is a single green solid line used to connect the upper and lower boundaries or adjacent grid nodes.

+3: Approximately 15 green diagonal lines running from upper left to lower right appear in the internal grid, distributed across multiple areas on the left, center, and right of the diagram. Each line is 1.5cm–5.5cm long, at an angle of approximately 25 degrees–60 degrees or 205 degrees–240 degrees, and is a single green solid line.

+3: Approximately 51 green diagonal lines running from lower left to upper right appear in the internal grid, distributed across multiple areas on the left, center, and right of the diagram. Each line is 1.5cm–6cm long, at an angle of approximately 120 degrees–160 degrees or 300 degrees–340 degrees, and is a single green solid line.

+3: The green grid lines on both sides of the central vertical zero-position dashed line are not interrupted by the dashed line. The green lines may intersect the gray dashed line but are not obscured by it. Line widths remain clear at intersections, and the green lines do not turn gray.

+5: Blue centerline sensor points appear in the diagram, totaling 10 or 11. Their labels include B114, B116, B117, B118, B119, B120, B121, B122, B123, B124, and B125. The points are arranged with slight undulations near the horizontal zero position and are located overall within 11cm–27cm from the left and 11cm–16cm from the top.

+3: The blue sensor points are circular, 0.18cm–0.20cm in diameter, filled blue with a color close to RGB 0, 90, 220, and have a dark blue outline or no outline. A black label appears beside each point, using Arial or Calibri at 12–14 points.

+5: Yellow boundary sensor points appear in the diagram, totaling no fewer than 20. Their labels include A201, A203, A205, A207, A209, A211, A301, A303, A308, A314, K908, K903, K899, K651, K657, K663, K670, and K679. The points are distributed near the upper, lower, left, and right boundaries of the green cross-section.

+3: The yellow sensor points are circular, 0.18cm–0.20cm in diameter, filled yellow with a color close to RGB 245, 230, 0, and have a green or dark gray outline with a line width of 0.3–0.75 points. A black label appears beside each point, using Arial or Calibri at 12–14 points.

+3: The yellow K-series points along the upper boundary are distributed near the upper green outline and include at least K908, K903, K899, K651, K657, K663, K670, and K679. K908, K903, and K899 are located from the upper-left to the center-left area, K651 is to the right of center, and K670 and K679 are in the upper-right area and noticeably higher than the points in the middle.

+3: The yellow A-series points along the lower boundary are distributed near the lower green outline and include at least A201, A203, A205, A207, A209, A211, A301, A303, A308, and A314. A201 through A211 are located from the lower-left to below the center, while A301 through A314 are located from the center-right to the lower-right area.

+3: The blue B-series points are arranged near the horizontal zero line. B114 is on the left, B121 is close to the vertical zero-position dashed line, and B124 and B125 are on the right. Each label is positioned close to its corresponding circle, approximately 0.1cm–0.5cm away, without noticeably obstructing the green lines.

+3: The sensor identifier text has no obvious missing characters, incorrect characters, or reversed order. The labels are black or dark gray, all labels are editable, and they do not severely overlap the points or green grid.

+3: A scale description box appears in the lower-left corner. It is 4.4cm–4.8cm wide and 2.4cm–2.7cm high, positioned 3.0cm–3.4cm from the left and 22.5cm–24.5cm from the top. Its border is a single gray solid line with a line width of 0.5 points, and its fill is white.

+3: Small green coordinate arrows appear inside the scale description box, including an upward Y-direction arrow and a rightward X-direction arrow. The arrows are single green solid lines, with a color close to RGB 20, 145, 45 and a line width of 0.75–1.25 points. The upward arrow is 0.5cm–0.8cm long at an angle of 90 degrees, and the rightward arrow is 0.7cm–1cm long at an angle of 0 degrees.
+1: The text “Y (Up),” “X (Right),” and “Displacement Scale: 1 mm” appears inside the scale description box. The font is Arial or Calibri, the font size is 9–10 points, and the color is black.

+3: A legend box appears in the lower-right corner. It is 6.5cm–7.0cm wide and 1.7cm–2cm high, positioned 28cm–30cm from the left and 21cm–23cm from the top. Its border is a single gray solid line with a line width of 0.5 points, and its fill is white.

+3: A blue circle with the text “Crown/Centerline Sensors” and a yellow circle with the text “Upper/Lower Boundary Sensors” appear inside the legend box. The circles are 0.16cm–0.20cm in diameter. The text uses Arial or Calibri at 11-13 points and is black.

+3: The positional relationship between the green grid lines and sensor points is appropriate. Yellow points are close to boundary lines or internal boundary lines, and blue points are close to the central zero line. The points are not concentrated in a single area and do not lie outside the green cross-section.

+3: The overall color scheme matches the original image: the main lines are green, the center sensors are blue, the boundary sensors are yellow, the coordinates and text are black or gray, the zero-position dashed lines are gray, and the scale and legend boxes have white fills and gray borders.

+3: All green cross-section lines, coordinate axes, dashed lines, the legend box, the scale box, sensor circles, and text labels are editable components and are not merged into a single non-editable image.
